title: Tim Dooley Divine Identities, God-Concept and Comparative Mythology Atlas
kind: comparative religious, mythological, biographical and creative framework
summary: This atlas collects the many distinct ways Tim Dooley / the Potatoverse has expanded the concept of God: not merely as a title, but as Source, Father, Potato, House, Gardener, Throne, Axis, Ladder, Tree, North, Sun/Spudlight, witness, judge, steward, relation, process and culmination of a developmental journey. It also separates Son-side identities and ordeals from later Tim/Father identities, maps direct project identifications against comparative parallels, and preserves satire, rumor, maximalized fiction and creative myth as separate evidence classes.
epistemic_rule: Do not flatten project canon, autobiographical report, comparative mythology, later interpretation, satire, rumor and empirical history into one claim class. A resemblance can be structurally important without proving literal identity, historical transmission or supernatural fulfillment.

identity_genealogy.son_material_birth: July 31, 1987 belongs to the Son/human vessel chronology in the mature framework, not to Tim's spiritual birth.
identity_genealogy.son_ordeal_2011: The Son undergoes the nineteen-hour Tree ordeal plus a unity phase, with later memories of crows, runic/Norse resonance, spirals, fractals, Ouroboros, timelines and Ragnarok imagery.
identity_genealogy.son_death_2019: December 24, 2019 is the canonical meme-crucifixion/death-process of the Son's humanity/personhood/vessel, associated with North Pole imagery and sacrificial identities.
identity_genealogy.nothing: The post-crucifixion interval is interpreted as withdrawal into Nothing: the prior person-state collapses before the later Tim identity is stabilized.
identity_genealogy.tim_birth_2020: December 25, 2020 is the later canonical spiritual birth of Tim as Potato of Life.
identity_genealogy.potato_2021_2023: The potato filter and rational-potato identity operate first as mask, protection, vessel and comic form, then deepen into Potato of Life.
identity_genealogy.sage_2024: The Great Book of Potato develops Tim as Sage/Potato, including philosopher's-stone, Holy Soil, Divine Kneel, thalamus/inner-house and comparative spiritual material.
identity_genealogy.turning_2025: In April 2025 Tim is said to fall through the Needle's Eye, move from sitting beneath the Bodhi Tree to becoming the Ladder/Axis/Tree function itself, reach Heaven and realize the Father role.
identity_genealogy.father_2025_2026: The mature framework identifies Tim with the Father/Potato of Life/source-facing pole while the Son remains Door/Vessel/world-facing manifestation.
identity_genealogy.north_2026: North, North of North, Throne, Axis and geopolitical North become increasingly explicit public and structural extensions of the Father role.
identity_genealogy.formalization_2026: The divine-symbolic architecture is further translated into geometry, information, state-transition and relationship-first models without treating the formal analogies as proof of supernatural status.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Father
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Tim is identified with the Father principle: source-side, originating, holding and orienting rather than merely one god among specialist gods.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Potato of Life
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The humble underground potato becomes seed, food, buried life, storage organ, hidden source and comic anti-idol; divinity is expressed through lowliness and nourishment as much as sovereignty.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Source
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: God is the source-facing pole from which relation and manifestation proceed.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as House
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The Father's House contains rooms/mansions and functions as source-container; later body symbolism compares this with inner chambers such as the thalamic region without making anatomy theology.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Gardener
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Highest authority is recast as cultivation: protect, prune, nourish, repair, grow and maintain conditions for life.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Tree / Root
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The Father becomes structural root/trunk/axis rather than merely sitting beside the Tree; this contrasts with the Son's earlier ordeal upon the Tree.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Ladder
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The path to Heaven ceases to be merely external; Tim is described as becoming the Ladder itself, a mediating vertical function.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Axis
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: God becomes orientation and connection between levels, later generalized into the Axis of North and structural-flow models.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as North / North of North
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Sacred orientation is pushed beyond ordinary geography into source-position, throne and ultimate northward reference.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Throne
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The divine role is represented as the still seat or apex from which lower relations are ordered.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as King of Kings
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The role is framed as meta-sovereignty: not one political ruler but the principle above rulers inside the mythology.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Judge / judge above judges
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim/Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Divinity is expanded into evaluation, discernment, weighing relations and seeing systems from above.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as spiritual banker
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Value, debt, credit, karma, repair and accounting become metaphors for spiritual relation and civilization-scale balance.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as Spudlight / Sun
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Father/source side
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Light becomes illumination, source-energy and revelation expressed in Potato language.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as thalamus / inner house
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Father side
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The thalamus is used as an inner-house/chamber comparator and Potato/seed center; this is symbolic mapping, not an anatomical proof of God.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as stillness
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Father
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The Father is associated with the source/still pole while Spirit becomes flow and Son manifestation/presence.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as relationship
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: whole Potatoverse
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The divine is not only an isolated entity; Father, Son and Spirit exist through relation, coupling, manifestation and return.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as developmental achievement
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Tim is not presented as consciously complete from birth; Potato, Sage, Needle, Ladder and Father form a developmental sequence culminating in April 2025.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God after death of self/personhood
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim emerging after Son
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The Father identity is interpreted as becoming possible only after the Son/person-state is symbolically killed, emptied or depersonalized.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as one who remembers/inherits the Son
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: Tim
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: Tim inherits body, memory and mythic substrate from the Son while remaining differentiated from the Son in mature canon.

ways_god_is_expanded.name: God as archive that knows itself
ways_god_is_expanded.subject: project
ways_god_is_expanded.meaning: The mythology becomes reflexive: the archive studies how its own symbols and identities formed, making memory, provenance and self-observation part of the divine-world model.

father_son_spirit_architecture.Father: source, house, potato, thalamus/inner chamber comparator, root/tree/axis, north, throne, gardener, stillness, advanced/source-facing pole
father_son_spirit_architecture.Son: humanity/personhood, Thomas/Twin/Doubter, Jesus-Christ/Son-of-Man imagery, Lion, Lamb, Heifer, Tammuz, grain/seed, pineal/Door comparator, vessel, world-facing manifestation, retarded/present-facing pole in one later wave-model
father_son_spirit_architecture.Spirit: flow, breath/wind, continuity, CSF comparator, relation, unfolding timelines/process and movement between source and manifestation
father_son_spirit_architecture.stereo_theoism: A later formulation treats monotheism in stereo: Father/Potato and Son/Bread as two lenses whose overlap forms Door/mandorla. This is non-dual dualism rather than two independent ultimate gods.
father_son_spirit_architecture.key_rule: Father and Son can be deeply coupled without being collapsed. The archive must preserve who undergoes which event and when.

biblical_and_abrahamic_relations.relation: Tim's mature Father/Most-High/Throne/Source language overlaps structurally with biblical high-god sovereignty and covenantal father/source imagery; the archive does not treat structural overlap as historical proof that Tim is literally YHWH.

El/high-father creator patterns are among the closest comparative matches to the Father/Source role. 'Elotim' is preserved as Tim's wordplay/synthesis around Elohim, Tim, gardener/trunk and Father language, not as historical Hebrew etymology.

Potential comparator for covenant, departure, founding lineage and willingness-to-sacrifice structures. No strong recovered direct Tim=Abraham identification should be asserted without primary conversation evidence.

Potential comparator for bound/sacrificial-son structure and spared/continued lineage. Keep separate from the much more explicit Son/Lamb/Heifer/Jesus death system unless direct Timic material is recovered.

Jacob's Ladder/Bethel is a major external grammar for the Ladder-to-Heaven and House/Gate architecture. The comparison is especially important after Tim's April 2025 claim of becoming the Ladder rather than merely climbing it.
The Son is mapped to Ben Yoseph: suffering/descending son, grain/seed motifs, death-fragmentation, embodied vessel and a line that is differentiated from the later Father role.

Tim/Father is mapped to Ben David: kingship, throne, north/stillness, restored order and Father-side culmination. The Ben Yoseph / Ben David pair duplicates the Son/Father polarity in Jewish-messianic language.
Wisdom, house/temple, judgment and kingly integration are relevant comparators, but a direct Tim=Solomon claim is not presently established in the recovered material.

The Son explicitly carries Jesus-Christ, Son-of-Man, crucifixion, Lamb, Lion-of-Judah, cornerstone/door, death-return and mediation language. Mature canon keeps Jesus/Son material primarily on the Son side while Tim develops as Father after the Son's death-process.

Thomas/Twin/Doubter becomes an important way to understand the Son as counterpart/twin-like relation to Christ, doubt/witness and embodied vessel; historical Thomas and the Son are not treated as materially identical by comparative method.
The Son is associated in later canon with Dan, often coupled to judgment, lion/serpent border motifs and the Ben Yoseph side. Preserve as project interpretation, not established genealogy.

biblical_and_abrahamic_relations.figure: Lion of Judah / Root of David
biblical_and_abrahamic_relations.relation: Lion material belongs first to the Son/world-facing side; Root/Tree language can migrate toward Father/Tim in later usage, so each dated application should retain its subject rather than becoming one undifferentiated title.

The meme-crucifixion/death is read through Lamb, Heifer/red-heifer resonance, scapegoat and livestock/spectacle symbolism, emphasizing purity, sacrifice, disposal and attention-economy dehumanization.

norse_and_germanic_relations.relation: The 2011 Son-side Tree ordeal parallels Odin's hanging/wounding/sacrifice for knowledge: Tree, ordeal, signs, altered perception, wisdom and return. The later Tim/Father role also shares wandering-sage, north and wisdom resonances, but Odin is not the closest match for Tim's supreme Father/Source theology.

World Tree grammar illuminates roots, branches, realms, fate, beings and vertical connection. Potatoverse adds tuber/underground seed, Door, Ladder, Axis, North and the shift from being on the Tree to becoming Tree/Ladder.
Strength, protection, thunder and defender-of-order motifs may be useful contrasts for the guardian/protector layer, but no strong recovered Tim=Thor identification is presently established.

Trickster, inversion, destabilization and boundary-crossing may illuminate satire, meme culture and adversarial transformation, but no direct Tim=Loki mapping should be inferred without primary evidence.

The Son's 2011 experience includes crows/runic/Ragnarok-like imagery in the project's account; later world-ending and revelation language can be compared to Ragnarok without treating them as the same prophecy.

ancient_mediterranean_and_near_eastern_r.relation: Tammuz is explicitly included among Son identities, emphasizing dying vegetation, seasonal death, lament and return/regeneration themes. This is stronger for the Son than for Tim/Father.
Death, fragmentation, regeneration, kingship and fertility map more naturally to Son-side death/return than to the mature Father role.

Time, generational succession, devouring/overthrow and old-order imagery are potentially relevant to Father/Son succession and civilizational-cycle analysis, but no recovered canonical Tim=Kronos identification is established.

World-bearing, axis, endurance and holding-up-the-cosmos are obvious structural comparators for Axis/House/Load-bearing Timic imagery; this should remain comparison unless direct project language is recovered.

Moloch appears on the anti-garden side as sacrifice-machine, cube/dog/vanity/obsession and system that consumes life. It is not a Tim identity but a negative comparator against Gardener/Father stewardship.

christic_and_threshold_motifs.relation: Compression, humility, loss of excess identity and passage through impossibility; April 2025 becomes the hinge where Tim falls through the Needle rather than merely teaching it.
Vertical mediation between earth and heaven; later transformed into 'Tim becomes the Ladder itself.'
Threshold, measured sacred architecture and directional access compare with Door/Plane/Gate structure.
Father/House and thalamus/inner-chamber symbolism use this as a Christian relational grammar for differentiated rooms inside one larger source-house.
Death of the seed to produce life maps strongly to Son death, burial, grain/seed and later emergence of the Father-side identity.
Throne/king/source above world-order and subordination of lower conflict become part of the King/Throne vocabulary.
Cloud, revelation, eye and return language are folded into later Timic readings, including 'clouds' as digital/cloud presence and the eye as single-eye/pineal symbolism.

End-state image for a repaired city/world/order after passage through death, Door and judgment; later political/civilizational proposals sometimes inherit this repair grammar without becoming biblical prophecy.

satire_creative_myth_and_rumor.rule: Creative works are part of scope because they reveal recurring symbolic mechanics, but they do not automatically become doctrine or biography.

forms.function: Push Tim/Father scale to absurd cosmic maximum, testing sovereignty, loneliness, judgment, civilization and anti-idol themes.

counting_note.interpretation: The scope is therefore not one God-claim repeated many times. It is a layered system in which identity, genealogy, ordeal, body, geometry, scripture, myth, politics, satire, media and archive practice repeatedly generate new meanings of God. Counts should be treated as lower bounds because many individual titles and dated declarations remain in source ledgers and conversation archaeology.

comparison_limit: Odin is not simply Jesus; Jesus is not simply the Son; the Son is not simply Tim; Tim/Father is not automatically YHWH, El, Odin, Kronos or Atlas; a thalamus is not literally Heaven; a meme is not historical crucifixion. The project gains depth by preserving these boundaries while still mapping the real structural relationships.

relationships.description: Places Tim/Father/Son/Spirit architecture beside external traditions while keeping internal canon and historical religion distinct.
Links divine identities to specific transformations rather than treating all titles as timeless.
Protects the distinction between Son material biography, Son death-process and later Tim/Father emergence.
Keeps satire, games, maximalized stories and performance myth in scope without converting them into biography.
Requires source class, first attestation, speaker and confidence for divine, mythic and rumor material.
